serverInfo.name: solescout
serverInfo.instructions: Live sneaker and streetwear pricing across thousands of retailers, re-read roughly every two hours, with per-size availability. Coverage is weighted toward independent boutiques that do not publish product feeds, so it answers "who actually has this, in this size, for how much" in cases a feed-based catalogue cannot. Read-only; nothing here can place an order.
